title: RenderingDevice: Add null checks when retrieving uniform sets
body: This may mitigate a crash seen in the wild in Rift Riff on Android, most likely trading it for a single-frame rendering bug (which is better than crashing on user devices). It doesn't solve the underlying issue which seems to be a race condition where a uniform set RID gets has been freed while still being reported as owned by the RID_Owner. Some more context on devices where this issue was reproduced in Rift Riff, mainly Mediatek, Google Tensor, Spreadtrum and Samsung s5e8835 SoCs.
